# Industrial robotics deal flow — 9 to 16 November 2026

## M&A

- **Aster Robotics — closed, $220 million, all cash.** Titan Automation completed its acquisition of Aster Robotics on 13 November after regulatory clearance, in cash, at the price announced 6 November ([Titan Automation release](https://titan.example/news/aster-closed)).

Chair: Titan now owns Aster outright; the cash-only terms and unchanged price are the clearest exit benchmark in this sector this week.

_Repeats checked by date: Gripworks' $40M Series B left out (announced 4 November, before the window)._
